title: Sanitell: payment plan 3, kit/auth apps (replayed)
goal: a customer is signed in, never a person; an sso_session belongs to one app; the listener mounts a customer app beside the panel
acceptance: export DOCKER_HOST=$(docker context inspect --format '{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}') TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 && (cd packages/kit && task check) && (cd services/auth && task check) && (cd services/notification && task check) && (cd services/verification && task check) && node tooling/dupes/dupes.mjs && node tooling/links/links.mjs && for m in packages/kit/store/migrations services/auth/internal/store/migrations services/notification/internal/store/migrations services/verification/internal/store/migrations; do test -z "$(ls $m | sed 's/_.*//' | sort | uniq -d)" || exit 1; done
prompt: Use catherd to implement Tasks 1–5 of {plan} in this repository, unattended. A1 The plan is final; do not redesign: every decision in it is confirmed (contracts §12 D1–D21, §14 binding, §14.6 codes, spec decisions 25–29). A2 docs/plans/2026-09-28-payment-0-contracts.md is the source of truth for names; a plan-versus-contracts conflict is a design finding, never a worker's call. A3 Every task is implemented with its tests; skip the plan's git commit steps, the run commits. A4 The gate is: {acceptance}. A5 Heavy commands run behind catherd lock --, one at a time; no Vite dev server. A6 English in code; no secrets, no .env files. Do not push or open a merge request.
